verdict.rationale: The latest hands-on probe shows a keyless client with a standard identified user agent could not reach aima.gov.pt at all. The TLS handshake failed certificate verification ('unable to get local issuer certificate'), so no robots.txt or guidance page was fetched. A prior dossier reportedly saw an open robots.txt and a 200 landing page, but that is only a secondhand note inside this probe. The current direct observation is a failure, so there is no present evidence that the public reading surface is reachable. This is a single attempt (repeating an identical roster-sweep failure) and may reflect an incomplete certificate chain rather than a deliberate wall, hence medium confidence.
